svg.title: A process, not a capability
svg.desc: A notebook page divided by a dashed line labelled 'the inference stops here'. Above the line, three connected boxes run left to right: a quiet API listing (aurora-red, green and blue alpha, created Oct 17, pulled in a day), arena testing (red faster but lower quality, green slower but better, blue untested), and reporting then silence (no docs, no pricing, no announcement). Below the line, a dashed box holds the aurora-equals-GPT-Image-3 mapping, called a guess with no primary source, beside a note listing what is still unknown: capability, speed and cost unmeasured, blue never tested, and no OpenAI comment.

text.tspan: Three unnamed models surfaced, were tested in public, and went unexplained.
created Oct 17; pulled in a day
Supported: the quiet listing, the arena sightings, OpenAI's silence, and the GPT-Image-2.5 baseline.
Not supported: any capability claim, the aurora-to-GPT-Image-3 mapping, or what blue can do.
